ms.report:
Milestone 4 — Resubmission Report
We have achieved the KPIs for Milestone 4 with the following evidences. This is a revised submission addressing the feedback received from the Catalyst review team.
1. Media Coverage and Promotion of Cardano NFT Shrine Stamps
Since the start of our project, we have actively worked to promote our Shrine Stamp NFT system and Cardano blockchain through multiple media channels. Below, we present only materials directly relevant to Cardano promotional content.
Shikoku Broadcasting — TV Program with Cardano Branding
Following the Catalyst team's decision not to approve Alt-Coin Navi as a qualifying media outlet (as it was identified as our own publication), we pursued independent television coverage through Shikoku Broadcasting Corporation.
Securing this broadcast required extensive negotiation. Japanese broadcasters initially required the removal of all references to Cardano, NFT, and related cryptocurrency terminology. We approached multiple media outlets to promote the Cardano NFT Shrine Stamp, but consistently encountered editorial policies that deleted terms such as "crypto," "Bitcoin," and "Ethereum" during the review process.
Despite these challenges, through sustained negotiation and discussion, we successfully secured the inclusion of Cardano, NFT, and the Cardano logo in the final program — a significant achievement given the restrictive media environment surrounding blockchain terminology in Japan.
Evidence: A short video clip and screenshots showing all Cardano logo placements in the broadcast are available here: Google Drive — Video & Screenshot Evidence

V2 submission — response to reviewer feedback
Thank you for the careful review and for the request for greater clarity. This V2 supplements V1 (which has already received one approval); it does not replace it.
Following your guidance on PCR format compliance, the submission is now split into two documents:
・Project Close-out Report (V2.1) — follows the official PCR template, sections A–K. Charity evidence (¥1,320,000 in bank-transfer receipts to Café Tabino Otomo, the disability-employment partner, and to a children's charity cafeteria) is documented under H. Impact, alongside both successes and items that did not work as intended. A note in Section H clarifies the three sources of charitable funding and confirms that no portion of the Catalyst grant was used for charitable transfers. https://drive.google.com/file/d/1p8MXQfRFJIlu8GoeCQtk8b0PEz8KE5PD/view?usp=drive_link
・Final Milestone PoA (V2) — addresses your four questions directly: (Q1) what "sustainable system" means, (Q2) the four NFT functions including how the Box actually unlocks via CIP-30 wallet signature plus SwitchBot, (Q3) charity proof with receipts, (Q4) the relationship between low digital-NFT sales and the holder website. https://drive.google.com/file/d/11RNFQnpd7mvAQPJPT2t7vYcIvZfKAkAG/view

Updated close-out video (V2): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vceWREjT1kU The V2 video walks through the close-out report and covers all five required elements: challenge and approach, progress and KPIs, demonstration, next steps, and why this project matters. The original V1 video (https://youtu.be/3Q9i8FF9w0s) remains available.
We appreciate the reviewer's time and are available to clarify any remaining points before final approval.
